{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_011}◆ Enable Bandit Power ramp Bandits grow stronger each year until they reach full strength.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_015}◆ Max party size Largest bandit war-party that can spawn (30-120).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_017}◆ Power ramp years Years from campaign start until bandits hit full power.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_019}◆ Mount damage multiplier Bandit cavalry hit damage scaling (1x-5x).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_021}◆ Enable bandit backup Bandits you fight call nearby war-parties to converge and hunt you.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_025}◆ Backup chance Chance each nearby bandit party answers the call (0-100%).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_027}◆ Max backup parties Most extra war-parties that can answer one call (0-5).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_029}◆ Reinforcement arrival delay Seconds before answered war-parties arrive mid-battle (5-90).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_031}◆ Bandit captivity Lose to bandits and they march you to their hideout and jail you.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_035}◆ Escape difficulty How hard it is to escape the hideout jail (1 easy - 5 hard).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_037}◆ Hideouts per clan How many hideouts each bandit clan can hold (1-5).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_039}◆ Respect biomes Bandit clans stay in their native biome (desert/forest/etc).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_043}◆ Allow vanilla hideouts Keep vanilla bandit hideouts alongside the clan-owned ones.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_047}◆ Hideout boss strength Bandit boss combat strength scaling (1x-3x).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_049}◆ Coin drop multiplier Coin loot multiplier per bandit slain (0.5x-3x).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_051}◆ Drop keepsakes Bandits drop themed keepsake trophies on defeat.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_055}◆ Use elite bonus Elite bandit kills drop richer loot than common ones.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_059}◆ Keepsake chance multiplier Adjust keepsake drop frequency (0.5x-3x).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_061}◆ Show keepsake notification Pop-up notice when a keepsake drops.

{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_076}Built rune by rune in conference with the Bannerlord engine.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_078}◆ Raid chance per hour Odds each hour that a culture musters a raid (1-20%).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_080}◆ Days between raids Per-culture rest after a raid; shrinks each year (1-60).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_082}◆ Max concurrent raids Raid operations allowed at the same time (1-10).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_084}◆ Max raid range How far from its hideout a war band hunts (50-500).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_086}◆ Raid muster size Troops a war band gathers before marching to raid (20-200).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_088}◆ Yearly raid escalation Bandits grow stronger + raid more often each year (0-100%).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_090}◆ Show map HUD Roadside infamy bar (preview — full HUD next update).
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_094}◆ Rank-up notifications Toast when your infamy rank rises.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_098}◆ HUD glow Firelight halo behind the roadside bar.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_102}◆ Quest alert Pulsing badge while a hunt pledge is active.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_106}◆ Hideout chief card Reveal card shown when assaulting or sneaking into a hideout.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_110}◆ Sneak shadow bar Stealth meter + spotted grace timer in hideout sneak-ins.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_114}◆ Battle AI panel BANDIT AI checklist at the start of bandit field battles.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_118}◆ Hideout alarm & meter Assault suspicion meter, camp alarm and reinforcement wave.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_122}◆ Bandit King panels Mad King + rebellion events as premium panels. OFF = plain chat line.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_126}◆ Rebellion as toasts Rebellion events show as compact toasts instead of full panels.
{=bp_pf_banditplusconsolev3_130}◆ Rebellion panels: bandit-driven only ON = only blockade-forced uprisings get the panel; OFF = every uprising.
